name: @rakenjs/examples
description: Renderer-agnostic example apps for the Raken family. Each example is a @rakenjs/app schema (state/events/derived/views) exported under its own subpath (e.g. @rakenjs/examples/todo); renderer playgrounds import the app-def and supply their own ui-views. Code-only — no renderer or UI imports.
author: Niko Helle

scripts.check:all: npm run typecheck && npm run test
